Import Setup Guide: Start by choosing what data to import and how the uploaded rows should be handled.
导入设置引导: 请先选择要导入的数据以及系统应如何处理上传文件中的每一行。

Import Setup Guide: This will update existing records only. Keep the ID column in the template so the system can match each row.
导入设置引导: 仅更新现有记录。请保留模板中的 ID 列，系统会用它匹配每一行。

Import Setup Guide: This will create new records. Leave the ID column blank unless you intentionally want to provide a record name.
导入设置引导: 将创建新记录。如无特殊需要请将 ID 列留空，系统会自动生成记录名称。

Import Setup Guide: Download the system template first, keep the headers unchanged, then upload the completed file for preview.
导入设置引导: 请先下载系统模板并保持表头不变，再上传填写完成的文件进行预览。

Import Setup Guide: Choose the document or master data that this file should import into.
导入设置引导: 选择此文件要导入的单据或基础资料。

Import Setup Guide: Choose whether the file should create new records or update records that already exist.
导入设置引导: 选择文件应创建新记录还是更新现有记录。

Import Setup Guide: Choose the document or master data that this file should import into, such as Supplier, Location, Purchase Order, or Journal Entry.
导入设置引导: 选择此文件要导入的单据或基础资料，例如供应商、地点、采购订单或记账凭证。

Import Setup Guide: Insert creates new records. Update changes existing records and requires the ID column from the template.
导入设置引导: 新增会创建新记录；更新会修改现有记录，并需要使用模板中的 ID 列。

Import Setup Guide: Keep enabled for bulk imports to avoid sending system emails while rows are being created or updated.
导入设置引导: 批量导入时建议保持开启，避免创建或更新数据时发送系统邮件。
